Now I may not be like twenty, but THIS, THIS RIGHT HERE, it’s was my everything, from staying up WAYYYY later than we should building awesome castles, to throwing ourselves headlong into battles we were sure to lose, we had the best times ever! So to Mojang, I would like to say thank you, for giving me so so many amazing memories with my lifelong friends.
